context: Kenji and Aoi observe their growing baby; small loving moment.
purpose: New parents in tender development witnessing.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: けんちゃん、視力、ようけ発達してるね、赤ちゃん。
lines.en: Ken-chan, his vision is developing so much. He's amazing.
lines.style: Soft, awed wonder. Warm gaze downward at the baby. Voice almost hushed — the tenderness of witnessing something small and new. Gentle exhale between phrases.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 父母として、毎日、感動するわ。
lines.en: We're his parents, and honestly… every day surprises us.
lines.style: Kansai-tinged warmth. Voice catches slightly on the admission. Slow, measured — a man marveling at something he didn't expect to feel this deeply. Genuine quiet pride underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 指、直ぐに、ようけ動かす!
lines.en: Look how much his little fingers move already!
lines.style: Bright delighted wonder, quick and light. Leans in closer. Genuine gasp of joy — not performed, but real. The kind of laugh that comes from watching something you love do something new.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 着けてる靴下、可愛いやな、ちっちゃい。
lines.en: Those little socks he's wearing are so cute.
lines.style: Kansai-soft and fond. Almost dreamy quality — he's looking at the baby, not at Aoi. Voice drops tenderly on the adjectives. The small observations that only a parent notices.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 愛情、深く、本当に感じる。
lines.en: You can really feel the love in this moment. It's deep.
lines.style: Quiet emotion close to the surface. Slightly thick voice, as if holding back tears of joy. Slow exhale. Not dramatic — just honest and full. Lingering on the last word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 飼い猫みたい、優しい目しとる!
lines.en: He's got such gentle eyes — like a sweet little cat.
lines.style: Kansai-warm and amused. Soft chuckle underneath. Tender observation delivered with gentle playfulness. Not mocking — protective, even in the humor. Voice warm as afternoon light.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.en: Hehe… this is what family happiness really looks like.
lines.style: Soft, genuine laugh. Grateful and peaceful. Voice settles into contentment. A quiet moment of recognition — this is enough, this is everything. Warmth without urgency.
